boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of California-Irvine, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend route for learning the UCI campus, finding useful student spaces, and fitting in art and recreation.

cards.title: Start with an official campus tour
cards.subtitle: Aldrich Hall flagpoles · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Register in advance, then use the 90-minute student-led tour to orient yourself to academic buildings, student life, and the central campus layout.
cards.short_summary: Get a guided first pass through campus before exploring on your own.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI says its in-person tours are led by Campus Representatives and last 90 minutes; advance registration is required.
cards.source_title: Campus Tours | University of California, Irvine
cards.access_notes: Register ahead; capacity is limited and walk-ons are not guaranteed.

cards.title: Walk the campus center
cards.subtitle: Aldrich Park · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Take a daylight loop through the central park and use the paths to notice the schools and plazas that connect back to Ring Road.
cards.short_summary: A central green-space walk that makes UCI’s circular plan easier to understand.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI describes Aldrich Park as the campus’s central park, with Ring Road forming a circular path around it.
cards.source_title: Aldrich Park | UCI Office of Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Pause at Infinity Fountain
cards.subtitle: Near the School of Physical Sciences · Aldrich Park
cards.notes: Use the fountain plaza as a short landmark stop, then continue along Ring Road toward your next campus destination.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable waypoint beside Aldrich Park.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI identifies Infinity Fountain as being in a small plaza near the School of Physical Sciences.
cards.source_title: Aldrich Park | UCI Office of Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Outdoor plaza; use as a navigation landmark.

cards.title: Find the sculpture garden
cards.subtitle: Below Humanities Plaza · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Take a quiet detour below Humanities Plaza to view the garden, then rejoin the central campus path at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A reflective art stop tucked below Humanities Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI says the Jao Family Sculpture Garden below Humanities Plaza celebrates notable Chinese philosophers.
cards.source_title: Aldrich Park | UCI Office of Undergraduate Admissions
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden; remain on public paths and observe posted rules.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the Information Center
cards.subtitle: A138 Student Center · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Stop inside the Student Center entrance for visitor information, campus maps, or directions before choosing the rest of your weekend route.
cards.short_summary: A practical on-campus help desk for navigation and visitor information.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI says the Information Center is just inside the Student Center entrance and welcomes visitors seeking information about the university.
cards.source_title: The Information Center at UCI | UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Listed weekend Information Center hours are 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on university holidays.

cards.title: Settle into the Courtyard Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: UCI Student Center · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Bring a notebook or laptop and use the lounge for a reset between stops; reserve a room online if you need a dedicated study space.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center study stop with bookable rooms nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCI Student Center says the Courtyard Study Lounge offers study rooms that can be reserved online and lists Wi-Fi, whiteboards, and power.
cards.source_title: UC Irvine Student Center & Event Services
cards.access_notes: Student Center building hours are listed as 7 a.m.–midnight daily, excluding university holidays.

cards.title: Browse Langson Library
cards.subtitle: Langson Library · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Walk through the library, locate the checkout desk and study areas, and save its hours page for a future research or reading session.
cards.short_summary: A first look at UCI’s humanities and social-sciences library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Libraries says Langson supports research and teaching in arts, humanities, education, social sciences, social ecology, business, and management.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s live hours calendar before visiting, including for holidays and recesses.

cards.title: Explore the UCI Arboretum
cards.subtitle: North campus near Jamboree Drive and Campus Drive
cards.notes: Plan a daytime visit to see plant communities from the California Floristic Province and South African collections; use the interactive map for directions.
cards.short_summary: A botanic-garden detour about a mile from the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI describes the Arboretum as a 12.5-acre botanic garden and research facility one mile from the main campus.
cards.access_notes: Use the Arboretum’s interactive campus-map link and verify visitor arrangements before traveling there.

cards.title: See what is on view at University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: 712 Arts Plaza · Claire Trevor School of the Arts
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition, then visit during gallery hours for a self-paced look at contemporary work on the arts campus.
cards.short_summary: A free, public art stop with rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI’s University Art Galleries lists the University Art Gallery at 712 Arts Plaza and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Visit | University Art Galleries | UCI Department of Art
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are listed as Tuesday–Saturday, noon–6 p.m.; check for holiday closures or changes.

cards.title: Locate the Anteater Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 680 California Avenue · UCI main campus
cards.notes: Walk through the facility area to find the courts, pool, climbing wall, and fitness spaces, then check recreation access options before a later workout.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation hub with multiple activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UCI Campus Recreation lists the Anteater Recreation Center at 680 California Avenue and identifies its courts, pool, climbing wall, and fitness areas.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current facility hours, eligibility, and any required membership or guest access before participating.
